summary: Approval-based Sentry SaaS service credits, not general AI-token or LLM API credits. Applicants must be founded in the last two years, have raised less than $5M venture capital and be new to paying for Sentry. A free Sentry account and organization slug are needed. No mandatory partner referral stated for the general application; separate YC/a16z speedrun portal offers do not stack. Program page states one-year credit expiry from joining. Live form accepts company, organization slug, founders, email, founding date and funding details. No application deadline stated and no application or redemption tested.
claim_steps: Confirm company founded within the last two years, less than $5M venture funding and new to paying for Sentry.
Create a free Sentry account/organization and record its organization slug.
Submit company website, org slug, founder names, email, founding date and funding details at https://sentry.io/for/startups/apply/.
If in YC or a16z speedrun, compare the separate portal deal; it cannot stack with this offer.
If approved, confirm your actual award and the 12-month expiry.
